newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lippo unit preserves stake in Medco.
newsitem.headline: Lippo unit preserves stake in Medco.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Citivest Asia Ltd will buy 4.375 million shares of financial firm MEDCO Holdings Inc to maintain its 67 percent stake in the company, a MEDCO official said on Monday.
MEDCO recently increased its capital to 700 million pesos from the previous 10 million pesos.
MEDCO told the Philippine Stock Exchange it would reissue 372,203 treasury shares and sell 4,003,375 unissued shares to Citivest in a cross sale scheduled on April 28.
The purchase would preserve Citivest's stake in MEDCO at about 67 percent.
A company official said the shares would be sold at 1.05 pesos per share. MEDCO Holdings was last traded on January 15, with the closing price at 2.70 pesos per share.
Citivest is part of Indonesian conglomerate Lippo Group.
